propertyDetails.description:
Distinguished 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Transitional-style home built by Thomas James Homes. Estimated home completion is Spring 2026.

Just inside the front porch is the living and dining room areas with a fireplace. Continue through the main floor to the great room with large doors that lead to the covered patio, and gourmet kitchen that includes an island with bar seating, walk-in pantry, and nook. The main floor comes complete with an ADU with kitchenette and en suite bedroom and bathroom.

Head upstairs to a spacious loft, laundry room with sink and storage, 3 secondary bedrooms, and 2 full bathrooms. Enjoy the luxurious grand suite, which includes a spa-like bath and walk-in closet, or step out to your own fully fenced yard, all in a prime Willow Glen location.
